note: 最精準的說法是看「它正在修飾 / 補充說明的那個名詞」，要看修飾的到底是「主詞」「受詞」還是「後面的名詞」

meanings.meaning: 人或動物自身「感受到」該情緒

examples.en: We are surprised.
examples.zh: 我們感到驚訝→主詞是人→ed

examples.en: The manager found the applicants interested in the new project.
examples.zh: 經理發現這些求職者對新專案感到很有興趣

meanings.meaning: 如果主詞是事情，即便那是讓『人』感到驚訝，也應該選 V-ing

examples.en: The movie is surprising (to us).
examples.zh: 這句話在描述 The movie（事情） 具有「令人驚訝」的特質，所以用 -ing

examples.en: We found the results of the survey to be very surprising , and different from what we expected.
examples.zh: 因為主要是在形容the results of the survey

examples.en: The proposed marketing strategy is interesting to the board members.
examples.zh: 這項提出的行銷策略對董事會成員來說令人感興趣

note: 可以有不同的動詞型態，但需要看句子本身

meanings.structure: 表達「客觀真理 / 科學事實」

examples.en: Our science teacher taught us last week that water boils at 100°C.
examples.zh: 我們自然老師上週教我們：水在攝氏 100 度沸騰❌ 不用 boiled

examples.en: Ancient astronomers discovered that the Earth revolves around the Sun.
examples.zh: 古代天文學家發現地球繞著太陽公轉❌ 不用 revolved

meanings.structure: 表達「目前依然成立的狀態、事實或特質」

examples.en: He told me yesterday that he lives in Taipei.
examples.zh: 他昨天跟我說他住在台北⭕ 用 lives：代表他現在依然住在台北（事實持續中）

examples.en: I knew you are a kind person.
examples.zh: 我以前就知道你是一個善良的人⭕ 用 are：因為你到現在依然是一個善良的人

examples.en: The manager said that the company has over 500 employees.
examples.zh: 經理說過公司有超過 500 名員工。⭕ 用 has：代表公司現在依然擁有 500 名以上的員工

examples.en: The man threatened to leak classified information to the newspapers after he was unfairly dismissed.
examples.zh: 在被不公平解僱後，他威脅要將機密資料洩漏給報社。❌不是一個永遠成立的事實或常態：這是一個在過去「點時間」已完成且一次性事件

note: 主要子句的主詞是「被執行/被處理」的對象。省略主詞與 be 動詞，只保留 p.p. (過去分詞)

meanings.structure: 省略了主詞 the product 和 be 動詞 was

examples.en: Although the product was introduced only last month, it has already sold out
examples.zh: 雖然上個月才上市，該產品已經售罄。

examples.en: Although introduced only last month, the product has already sold out.

note: 當主詞轉變的時候，主要子句的主詞自己「發出/執行」這個動作，省略主詞，動詞改為 V-ing

meanings.structure: 省略了主詞 Mr. Smith，動詞 signed 必須改為 signing

examples.en: Before Mr. Smith signed the contract, he read all the clauses carefully.
examples.zh: 在簽署合約之前，史密斯先生仔細閱讀了所有條款

examples.en: Before signing the contract, Mr. Smith read all the clauses carefully.

note: 其實都有「自從」的意思，所以後面通常會加 have+v.ed

examples.en: Since 2015, the company has expanded its operations into European markets.
examples.zh: 自 2015 年以來，該公司已將業務擴展至歐洲市場

examples.en: Since the meeting, our team has been working on the new design.
examples.zh: 自那次會議以來，我們團隊就一直在製作新設計

meanings.structure: Since + 過去時間點 / 名詞短語, have/has + p.p

examples.en: Since Ms. Lee joined our company last year, sales have increased by 20%.
examples.zh: 自從李女士去年加入我們公司以來，銷售額已增長了 20%

examples.en: He has lived in Taipei since he graduated from college
examples.zh: 自從大學畢業以來，他一直住在台北

meanings.structure: Since 過去句子, 主詞 + have+ p.p.

meanings.meaning: Since 子句的主詞與主要子句的主詞相同時，可以省略主詞

examples.en: Since taking over the project, David has resolved several key problems.
examples.zh: 自從接手這個專案以來，大衛已經解決了幾個關鍵問題

meanings.structure: Since + V-ing, 主詞 + have/has + p.p.
